update_log: Baseline initialization of major global international organizations, their headquarters, establishment years, and key functional focus areas for International Relations Static GK.

geneva_switzerland_cluster.key_focus: Directing and coordinating authority for international public health within the United Nations system.
Regulating and facilitating international trade between nations. Replaced the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT).
Setting international labor standards and promoting social and economic justice. Created under the Treaty of Versailles.
Promoting the protection of intellectual property throughout the world.

washington_dc_usa_cluster.key_focus: Fostering global monetary cooperation, securing financial stability, and providing short-to-medium term balance-of-payments financial assistance.
Providing long-term financial products, loans, and technical advice to developing nations to reduce poverty and promote shared prosperity.

new_york_usa_cluster.key_focus: Maintaining international peace and security, developing friendly relations among nations, and achieving international cooperation.
Providing humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide.
Helping countries eliminate poverty, achieve sustainable economic growth, and human development.

vienna_austria_cluster.key_focus: Promoting the safe, secure, and peaceful use of nuclear technologies while inhibiting its use for any military purpose.

vienna_austria_cluster.organization: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)
vienna_austria_cluster.key_focus: Coordinating and unifying the petroleum policies of its member countries to ensure stable oil markets. Founded in Baghdad.

other_major_global_organizations.organization: UNESCO (UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization)
other_major_global_organizations.key_focus: Promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, arts, sciences, and culture.
An intergovernmental military alliance implementing the North Atlantic Treaty for collective defense.
The principal judicial organ of the United Nations. Settles legal disputes submitted by states.
An NGO focused on combating global corruption and preventing criminal activities arising from corruption (publishes the Corruption Perceptions Index).
The supreme authority of the modern Olympic Movement, responsible for organizing the modern Olympic Games.

regional_groups_high_frequency.organization: SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation)
regional_groups_high_frequency.key_focus: Regional intergovernmental organization and geopolitical union of states in South Asia. Established in Dhaka.
Promoting intergovernmental cooperation and facilitating economic, political, security, and sociocultural integration among Southeast Asian nations.
Multilateral development bank established by the BRICS states to support public or private projects through loans, guarantees, and equity participation.
Regional development bank focused on promoting social and economic development in Asia and the Pacific.
Multilateral development bank that aims to improve economic and social outcomes in Asia by investing in high-quality infrastructure.
